description: Kirstin Kahaloa has experience where it counts. The combination of her experience and her commitment makes her the most qualified candidate to represent West Hawaiʻi’s new District 6, representing parts of the area from Kailua to Honaunau, in the Hawaiʻi State House of Representatives.

title: Experience — Kahaloa For Kona
